senses.gloss:
रच् रच्, i. 10, रचय, Par.
 1. To make mechanically, Megh. 75.
 2. To make, Rām. 2, 13, 12; Kathās. 3, 66 (गतागतम्, literally a going and returning, i. e. looking on him and turning away her eye).
 3. To arrange, Gīt. 5, 10.
 4. To compose, Pañc. 5, 11.
 5. To adorn, Megh. 67.
 6. To prepare, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.
 7. To string, Pañc. iii. d. 235.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रचित, Written.
 --Caus. रचय, To cause to make, Utt. Rāmac. 127, 14 (मम हृदयं तस्नुन्न् अवधानं रचयति, Causes my heart to fix itself only on him, i. e. fills it with love).
 --With the prep. आ आ, आरचित, Put on, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 6.
 --With वि वि, विरचित,
 1. Contrived, arranged, Pañc. 86, 18; Ragh. 5, 76.
 2. Made, Megh. 19.
 3. Ornamented.
 4. Composed, Megh. 84; written, Pañc. 103, 4.
 --Cf. Lat. locare; A.S. logian, To place; Lat. locus; A.S. loh.

रचना रच् + अना, f.
 1. Making, work, Lass. 83, 4; Kathās. 26, 283 (कनक-, f. Being made, built, of gold.)
 2. Orderly arrangement.
 3. Dressing [] of the hair.
 4. Stringing flowers.
 5. Suspending garlands.
 6. The arrangement of troops, Pañc. 9, 23.
 7. Composition, Rājat. 5, 380; literary composition.
 --Comp.
